compatibility.source: Verified failing by EasyPlay on an M4 Mac, Game Porting Toolkit 3.0
notes: Not a game. A free DirectX 11 benchmark, kept as the preset that documents a hard limit of the compatibility engine.

Heaven 4.0 ships only a 32-bit engine binary, and Apple's D3DMetal is a 64-bit-only library — there is no 32-bit host-side Direct3D module in Game Porting Toolkit at all. So this title can never reach D3DMetal, whatever the preset asks for.

Wine does not report that fallback: it serves its OpenGL renderer instead, which reports feature level 10.1 and a GeForce 8800 GTX that does not exist. EasyPlay flags the mismatch before launch rather than letting it look like a preset problem.
Requires the engine's data-path arguments; the vendor's own heaven.bat goes through a GUI launcher that supplies them.

hints: Inno Setup installer, run unattended — nothing to click.

knownIssues.title: Heaven crashed while loading its scene
knownIssues.fix: The 32-bit engine crashes partway through startup under this Wine build. There is no preset fix — it is a limitation of running a 2013 32-bit engine on this backend.

knownIssues.title: Heaven couldn't find its data files
knownIssues.fix: The engine was started without its data-path arguments. This preset supplies them; running Heaven.exe by hand will not.
